title: Racing the Wind

lesson.themeZh: 一次看似顺利的飞龙车旅程如何变成远疆危机
learningObjectivesZh: 说明Perda期待前往Mount Mystery的原因及选择飞龙车的背景
理解飞行途中不使用魔法的原因，以及众人休息前后的事件顺序
根据环境变化和Gunt离开的画面判断旅程发生了什么意外

sections.title: Preparing for the Dragon-Coach Trip
sections.summaryZh: Perda兴奋地准备前往Mount Mystery，期待见到Zella和朋友们并参观洞穴。Zann解释了选择飞龙车的原因：Gunt熟悉飞龙，能够更快地带大家抵达。Perda还注意到一只通常凶猛的wind racer竟然温顺地让Gunt抚摸。

sections.title: A Fast Flight and a Quiet Nap
sections.summaryZh: 大家登上封闭式飞龙车。Gunt提醒他们飞行时不要使用魔法，以免分散飞龙的注意力。飞行速度很快，众人喝了冰凉的airberry juice后决定小睡，并请Gunt到达时叫醒他们。

sections.title: The Wrong Destination
sections.summaryZh: Perda醒来后发现自己昏昏沉沉，外面也异常黑暗。Boz确认他们并未抵达Mount Mystery，而是被带到了Far Frontier。最后，Perda看见Gunt正骑着一条飞龙离开，另一条飞龙跟在后面。

questions.question: Why was Perda looking forward to the trip to Mount Mystery?

options.text: She wanted to buy new blankets for the airship.
She hoped to learn how to drive the dragon coach.
She was excited to meet Zella and her friends and see the cave.
She planned to visit the palace menagerie.

questions.explanation: Perda期待这次旅行，因为她想见到Zella和她的朋友们，也想看看Mount Mystery的洞穴。

questions.question: Why did Gunt's dragon coach seem like a good way to reach Mount Mystery?

options.text: Gunt was an expert with dragons and expected the trip to take only a few hours.
The coach could travel through a wormhole without the researchers noticing.
The coach did not need dragons or any other power.
It allowed everyone to use magic during the flight.

questions.explanation: Gunt是宫廷动物园的负责人，熟悉飞龙。他表示飞龙车只需几个小时，比使用传送魔法或cloud gliders更快。

questions.question: What surprised Perda when Gunt patted one of the wind racers?

options.text: The dragon immediately flew away.
The dragon refused to stand near the airship.
The dragon had lost its ability to fly.
The dragon acted tame even though wind racers were usually fierce.

questions.explanation: Perda知道wind racers通常很凶猛，不会让人抚摸；但Gunt身边的那只却表现得很温顺，因此她很惊讶。

questions.question: Why did Nax stop the researcher from using magic during the flight?

options.text: The airship had already reached its destination.
Gunt had warned that magic might distract the dragons.
The airberry juice would become warm if magic was used.
The researcher had forgotten how to use magic.

questions.explanation: Gunt在出发前提醒大家，飞行时使用魔法可能会分散飞龙的注意力。Nax因此及时阻止研究员施法。

questions.question: What did the group discover after waking from their nap?

options.text: They had arrived at Mount Mystery earlier than expected.
The dragons had stopped because they were tired.
They had been taken to the Far Frontier, and Gunt was flying away on a dragon.
Gunt had gone ahead to prepare a place for them.

questions.explanation: 醒来后，众人发现周围一片漆黑，Boz确认这里是Far Frontier而不是Mount Mystery。Perda随后看到Gunt骑着一条飞龙离开。

reviewNotes: 基于 GitHub Actions Run 43201460328 的真实官方素材：46段英文Text、84条字幕时间轴，Storybook HEAD HTTP 200；官方播放器标题为 Red Magic, The New Heroes 13: Racing the Wind，与本集标题 Racing the Wind 匹配。3个教学分段按本集段落及真实字幕时间轴划分。5道原创英文剧情理解题分别定位 p1、p7、p14、p17/p28、p41/p45/p46，覆盖出行目的、交通选择、飞龙异常、飞行规则和结尾发现。逐题核对四个不重复选项、唯一答案和具体中文解析；未使用其他集或原著剧情。
